title: Similar structures under Menkaure (2+2) and the Sphinx (one)
place_text: Menkaure pyramid and Sphinx, Giza, Egypt

tellings.quote: that we found in Khafre we found the same thing also in Menkaure and also under the Sphinx.

plain: A scientist named Filippo Biondi, who scanned the ground beneath the pyramids of Giza in Egypt, says the hidden structures he found under the pyramid of Khafre show up under its neighbours too: two plus two under the pyramid of Menkaure and one under the Sphinx. He tells Michels first-hand that "we found the same thing also in Menkaure and also under the Sphinx." If so, the whole plateau would sit on a planned underground system far older or larger than anyone has admitted.
